description: Angular component for managing a list of alarm rule filter predicates, including adding, removing, and editing predicates with dialog support.

classes.name: AlarmRuleFilterPredicateListComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for a list of alarm rule filter predicates.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes predicates to the form array.

methods.name: removePredicate
methods.description: Removes a predicate at a specified index.

methods.name: addPredicate
methods.description: Adds a new predicate, opening dialog if complex.

methods.name: createDefaultFilterPredicate
methods.description: Creates a default filter predicate based on type and complexity.

methods.name: openComplexFilterDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for editing complex filter predicates.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model with current predicates.
